 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anish Dayal
 Order
% 18.12.2023 CM APPL. 65360/2023 (for delay in filing)
1. This is an application under section 5 of the Limitation Act. 1963 seeking condonation of delay in filing the present appeal.
2. For the reasons stated in the application, the delay of 135 days in filing the present appeal is condoned.
3. The application stands disposed of.

1. This is an appeal under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 impugning the judgment dated 08.05.2023 passed by the Additional District Judge ADJ, Rohini, New Delhi ('Reference Court') in LAC No. 181/2019 seeking further enhancement of the compensation amount in respect of award No. 12/2005-06/DC/(NW) pertaining to the land acquired of Village Barwala, Delhi.
